# Expert report, with the quoted passage in its original context (fixture)

> **FIXTURE — not a real source.** Written for the test suite. The numbers illustrate a structure; they are not evidence about the world.

The following passage is the original context of a frequently quoted sentence.

> The statistics cannot show that migration causes crime. What they show is that the
> recorded suspect rate for some groups is higher than for others, and that this
> difference is largely explained by age structure, sex ratio and social situation.
> A causal reading of the raw figures is therefore not supported by the data.

The report continues with a discussion of data limitations, including the difference
between suspects and convictions and the effect of reporting behaviour on recorded
figures.
